result.instructions: Tools for MemberSuite, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which individuals joined this month, and what are their memberships?"; "Show every active member whose email address is at example.org."; "List the people registered for our spring conference event.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes MemberSuite data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run membersuite_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run membersuite_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run membersuite_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. membersuite_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: membersuite_whoami
tools.title: Who am I
tools.description: Return the API user and tenant that this connection uses, including ReceivesMemberBenefits status fields. Good first call. REST: GET /platform/v2/whoami.

tools.name: membersuite_search_individuals
tools.title: Search individuals
tools.description: Search individual contacts (people) with an MSQL statement, for example SELECT LocalID, FirstName, LastName, EmailAddress FROM Individual WHERE (LastName = 'Smith'). Use the ID column to update a person later. REST: GET /crm/v1/individuals/{tenantId}?msql=.

msql.description: MSQL statement, from a MemberSuite Console Advanced Search (choose MSQL in the output dropdown).

tools.name: membersuite_search_memberships
tools.title: Search memberships
tools.description: Search membership records with an MSQL statement, for example SELECT Owner.Name, Type.Name, JoinDate, ExpirationDate, ReceivesMemberBenefits FROM Membership. ReceivesMemberBenefits = true means an active member. REST: GET /membership/v1/memberships/{tenantId}?msql=.

msql.description: MSQL statement, from a MemberSuite Console Advanced Search (choose MSQL in the output dropdown).

tools.name: membersuite_run_msql
tools.title: Run an MSQL query
tools.description: Run any MSQL statement across modules, including joins. Use it for event registrations, for example SELECT LocalID, Individual.FirstName, Individual.LastName FROM EventRegistration('{eventGuid}') WHERE (CancellationDate IS NULL AND OnWaitList = 0). Pages with startPosition (row offset). REST: POST /platform/v2/dataSuite/executeSearch.

msql.description: MSQL statement, from a MemberSuite Console Advanced Search (choose MSQL in the output dropdown).

start_position.description: Record offset of the first row (0 = first page).

tools.name: membersuite_list_saved_searches
tools.title: List public saved searches
tools.description: List the public saved searches in the Console, with their IDs. Filter by part of the name (letters, digits, spaces, _ . -). Use an ID with membersuite_run_saved_search. REST: POST /platform/v2/dataSuite/executeSearch with SavedSearch MSQL.

name_contains.description: Part of the saved search name.

tools.name: membersuite_run_saved_search
tools.title: Run a saved search
tools.description: Run one public saved search by its ID and return its records. The ID comes from membersuite_list_saved_searches. REST: GET /platform/v2/dataSuite/executeSavedSearch/{savedSearchId}.

tools.name: membersuite_update_individual
tools.title: Update an individual
tools.description: Change the listed fields of one individual (contact). Only the fields you pass change. Pass standard fields in fields (for example FirstName, EmailAddress, Work_PhoneNumber) and custom fields (names ending __c) in custom_fields. Idempotent: the same call twice leaves the same data. Test in a MemberSuite Sandbox first. REST: PATCH /crm/v1/individuals/patch/{individualId}.

individual_id.description: Individual GUID (the ID column from membersuite_search_individuals).

fields.description: Standard fields to change, for example { "FirstName": "Joey" }.

custom_fields.description: Custom fields to change; names end in __c, for example { "AreaofExpertise__c": "Doctor" }.

prompts.title: Get started with MemberSuite
prompts.description: What you can do with MemberSuite here, with example requests to try.
